 Sikorsky S-92A+ Selected as Korean Presidential Helicopter
 6th November 2026 Defence Equipment Home > Defence Equipment > Sikorsky S-92A+ Selected as Korean Presidential Helicopter Sikorsky selected to continue nearly two decades of Presidential transport in the Republic of Korea with four S-92A+ helicopters [Rendering courtesy of Sikorsky] 
 Sikorsky has been selected to deliver the S-92A+ to the Republic of Korea Air Force (ROKAF) for its Presidential Helicopter II programme.
 ~
 Press Release, Stratford CN, 06 November 2026 : Sikorsky, a Lockheed Martin company, has been selected to deliver the S-92A+ helicopter, the next-generation variant of its S-92 helicopter, to the Republic of Korea Air Force (ROKAF) for its Presidential Helicopter II programme.
 Lockheed Martin and Sikorsky’s partnership with the Republic of Korea spans more than 70 years, including Black Hawk, Seahawk and S-92 helicopter programmes. Since taking delivery of three S-92 helicopters in 2007, the ROKAF has relied on the platform for nearly two decades of safe and reliable Presidential transport. S-92 helicopters have also supported Korea Coast Guard search and rescue operations, along with firefighting and other lifesaving missions for South Korea’s National 119 Rescue Headquarters, part of the country’s National Fire Agency.
 For the new Presidential fleet, Korea Aviation Engineering & Maintenance Service (KAEMS), a subsidiary of Korea Aerospace Industries, will perform in-country mission equipment completion for the S-92A+ helicopters. The contract also includes additional special mission equipment and sustainment support, including critical spare parts and field service representation.
 “We are deeply honoured that the S-92A+ has been selected as the Republic of Korea’s Presidential helicopter. Building on the Republic of Korea Air Force’s long-term experience operating the S-92A, we are confident the S-92A+ will continue supporting this critical mission with the highest standards of safety and reliability,” said Wonik Lee, South Korea country executive for Lockheed Martin. “The S-92 platform’s shared heritage in Presidential transport across the Republic of Korea, the United States and other nations makes this selection especially meaningful. Together with Korean aerospace partner KAEMS’ participation in the program, this milestone reflects Lockheed Martin’s longstanding commitment to the ROK-U.S. alliance, national defence and defence industry cooperation.”
 S-92A+ Advances Proven Aircraft: For head-of-state and VIP transport, the S-92 combines best-in-class safety and reliability with long-range, all-weather capability and a spacious, quiet cabin tailored for executive travel. The S-92A+ builds on these proven strengths with upgraded engines, a new Phase IV main gearbox and increased payload or fuel capacity to enhance performance and mission flexibility.
 With more than 2.6 million fleet flight hours, an average lifetime availability rate of over 90% and more than 300 aircraft delivered across 28 countries, the S-92 supports head-of-state and VIP transport, offshore energy and search and rescue missions. The platform also serves as the foundation for the US Marine Corps’ VH-92A Patriot Presidential helicopter, continuing Sikorsky’s legacy of transporting every US president since 1957.
 Sikorsky is ramping up S-92A+ production at its facilities in Stratford, Connecticut, and Owego, New York, with capacity to produce up to twelve aircraft annually. These efforts reflect Sikorsky’s continued commitment to modernising the S-92 platform and supporting its global customer fleet today and into the future.
